summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an unsecured, unsubordinated senior notes offering denominated in dollars, alongside a separately announced but unregistered euro notes offering; neither is conditioned on the other. Coupon, maturity, principal amount, and pricing are left blank pending completion. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes per the use-of-proceeds section. The notes carry a change-of-control repurchase event at 101% plus accrued interest, standard investment-grade covenant structure, minimum denominations of $2,000, and book-entry delivery via DTC, Clearstream and Euroclear. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, settlement timing and any leverage implications.
